name: Last Night in Wickermoor
summary: Sergeant Gaunt would like the village to have one last evening together, with three goodbyes he can name.

stages.journal: Sergeant Gaunt asked us to sit with the village a while on its last night: three goodbyes at the Round.
stages.hint: Say goodbye to Gaunt, Tamsin Ledger and Marianna Grey at the Round.

stages.journal: We sat with the three of them, and it was the best hour of the whole sorry business.
We told Sergeant Gaunt there was no time. He saluted stiffly, and the village watched us go.
